settings.help:
This setting detremines if End of Manufacturing will be triggered on first boot of the platform after flashing.
Note: When this setting is enabled Intel(R) CSME will enter End of Manufacturing regardless of the descriptor settings.
settings.label: EOM on First Boot Enabled
settings.name: EomFirstBootEnabled

settings.help:
This setting deteremines which settings will be automatically commited during End of Manufacturing flows.
Note: The FPFs, RPMB / RPMC and set manufacturing mode settings are mandatory and cannot be overridden revenue parts. Simulation can be done on non-revenue part with the Hardware binding set to disabled.
settings.label: Flexible EOM setting options
settings.name: FlexibleEomSettings
options: Do not lock Descriptor and OEM Configs

settings.help:
This setting detremines if End of Manufacturing will be triggered on first boot of the platform after flashing.
Note: When this setting is enabled Intel(R) CSME will enter End of Manufacturing regardless of the descriptor settings.
settings.label: EOM on First Boot Enabled
settings.name: EomFirstBootEnabled

settings.help: This setting allows customers to disable Intel(R) AMT on the platform and force the platform into Standard Manageability mode.  Note: This setting is only applies to Desktop and Workstation platforms.
settings.label: Intel(R) AMT Supported
settings.name: AmtSupported

settings.help: This setting enables Intel(R) Trusted Device Setup on the platform
settings.label: Enable TDS Capabilities
settings.name: EnableTDS

settings.help: This setting allows customers to hide the Firmware Update option in the MEBx interface.
settings.label: Hide MEBx Firmware Update Control
settings.name: HideMEBxFwUpdCtrl

settings.help: This setting allows customers to determine the power up state for ISH.
settings.label: Integrated Sensor Hub Initial Power State
settings.name: IshPowerUpState

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable / disable the KVM Redirection capabilities of the firmware.  Note: If this setting have been set to disabled it cannot be re-enabled once the descriptor has been locked.
settings.label: KVM Redirection Supported
settings.name: KvmSupported

settings.help: This setting enables the Dynamic Application Loader capability of the Intel(R) ME Firmware.
settings.label: Firmware Dynamic Application Loader
settings.name: MEDynAppLoad

settings.help: This setting allows the customer to configure the powerwell that will be used by Intel(R) Integrated LAN.  Note: Recommended setting is SLP_LAN#.
settings.label: LAN Power Well
settings.name: MELanPowerWell

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable / disable the Wireless LAN CLINK signal through Intel(R) ME firmware.  Note: For using Intel(R) vPro Wireless solutions this should be set to Yes.
settings.label: Intel(R) ME CLINK Signal Enabled
settings.name: MeClinkEnable

settings.help: This setting allows customers to determine the power up state for Intel(R) AMT or Standard Manageability.  Note: If this setting is disabled Intel(R) AMT or Standard Manageability can still be re-enabled through the MEBx interface.
settings.label: Manageability Application initial power-up state
settings.name: MngAppPowerUpState

settings.help: This setting allows customers to permenantly disable Intel(R) AMT and Standard Manageability mode on the platform.
settings.label: Manageability Application Supported
settings.name: MngAppSupported

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable / disable Intel(R) ME Network Services on the platform.  Note: If this setting is disabled Intel(R) AMT will also be disabled.
settings.label: Intel(R) ME Network Services Supported
settings.name: NetServicesSupported

settings.label: Processor Emulation
settings.name: ProcEmulation
options: EMULATE Intel (R) Xeon (R) Manageability capable Processor

settings.help: This setting determines if missing processor detection is enabled on Desktop / Workstation platforms.  Note: This feature will only work if the platform has the appropriate glue logic present.
settings.label: Missing Processor Detection Alert
settings.name: ProcMissingDetect

settings.help: This setting permanently disables Intel(R) PTT in the firmware image.
settings.label: Intel(R) PTT Supported
settings.name: PttSupported

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable / disable firmware Transport Layer Security support.  Note: If this is disabled TLS will be permanently disabled in the firmware image.
settings.label: Transport Layer Security Supported
settings.name: TlsSupported

settings.label: Intel(R) Precise Touch and Stylus Enabled
settings.name: TouchEnabled

settings.help: This setting configures the idle timeout value before Intel(R) AMT enters into an off state.
settings.label: Intel(R) AMT Idle Timeout
settings.name: AmtIdleTimeout

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable the Intel (R) ME firmware to trigger an automatic platform reset if either the MEI or Agent Presence are in a hung state.  Note: This feature only allows one reset at a time when the watchdog expires.  After this feature has triggered a reset it must be re-armed for re-use via management console.
settings.label: Intel(R) AMT Watchdog Automatic Reset Enabled
settings.name: AmtWdAutoReset

settings.help: Profile applied during each boot.
settings.label: Boot Profile
settings.name: BootProfile

settings.help: Allows the OEM to control FW features to assist with pre-production platform debugging.  This control has no effect if used on production silicon.  Note: Certain options will do not work when the descriptor is locked (See FW Bring-up Guide for setting details).
settings.label: Debug Override Pre-Production Silicon
settings.name: DbgOverridePreProdSi

settings.help: Allows the OEM to control FW features to assist with production platform debugging.  Note: Certain options will do not work when the descriptor is locked (See FW Bring-up Guide for setting details).
settings.label: Debug Override Production Silicon
settings.name: DbgOverrideProdSi

settings.help: This setting enables Delayed Authentication Mode on the platform.
settings.label: Delayed Authentication Mode Enabled
settings.name: DelayedAuthMode

settings.help: This setting allows customers to enable / disable Embedded Host Based Configuration. EHBC is primarily intended for use in embedded systems, please leave this setting disabled for business client systems.
settings.label: Embedded Host Based Configuration Enabled
settings.name: EhbcEnable

settings.help: Boot profile used when system instability is detected.
settings.label: Failsafe Boot Profile
settings.name: FailsafeBootProfile

settings.help: True = Allows user to change boot profile via BIOS menu or 3rd party application False = Prevents user from changing boot profile via BIOS or 3rd party application.  Note: When false, Failsafe Boot Profile must be the same as Boot Profile.
settings.label: Profile Changeable
settings.name: ProfileChangeable

settings.help:
This setting configures the FPF Hardware binding behavior for the platform image.  

                                                                                                                                                     If this setting is enabled FPF Hardware binding will occur when platform close manufacturing flow is executed with Intel® FPT. 

                                                                                                                                                     If this setting is disabled FPF Hardware binding will not take place when close manufacturing flow is executed. 

                                                                                                                                                     Note: For Revenue parts this setting will be ignored and FPF Hardware binding will take place when close manufacturing flow is executed.
settings.label: FPF Hardware Binding Enabled
settings.name: FpfHwBindingEn

settings.help: This setting enables the firmware Automatic Built in Self Test which is executed during first platform boot after initial image flashing.
settings.label: Automatic Built in Self Test
settings.name: FwAutoBist

settings.help: This setting allows configuration of an OEM unique ID to ensure that customers can only update their platform with images from the OEM of the platform.
settings.label: Firmware Update OEM ID
settings.name: FwUpdateOemId

settings.help: This option is for entering the raw hash 256 bit string for the Graphics uController.
settings.label: GuC Encryption Key
settings.name: GucHash

settings.help: This setting enables descriptor unlock of the ME Region when the HMRFPO message is sent to firmware prior to BIOS End of POST.
settings.label: Intel(R) ME Region Flash Protection Override
settings.name: HmrfpoEnable

settings.help: This setting enables KVM Screen blanking capabilities in the firmware image.  Note: This feature is dependent on processor level support.
settings.label: Firmware KVM Screen Blanking
settings.name: KvmScreenBlnkEnable

settings.help: This setting determines which port for LSPCON will be connected to the HDCP 2.2 bridge adapter Display 1.
settings.label: LSPCON Internal Display Port 1 - LSPCON / 4K
settings.name: Lspcon4kdisp

settings.help: Defines the 8-bits MCTP address and 7-bits SMBus address of the EC on SMLink1 bus. This value is needed if EC is using the MCTP protocol. The SMBus (LS byte) must be from 0x01 to 0x7f (and should not overlap with any SMBus address in PCH Strap 11).  The EID (MS byte) must be outside 0x01 through 0x07.
settings.label: MCTP EC Address
settings.name: MctpEcAddress

settings.help: Defines the ME's 8-bits MCTP Endpoint IDs for each SMBus physical interface (SMBus, SMLink0 and SMLink1). These values are needed for FW to communicate with MCTP end points. For each of these 3 bytes, a value of 0x00 means not used, and values 0xFF or 0x01 - 0x07 or 0x20 - 0x2F are not allowed.
settings.label: MCTP Stack Configuration
settings.name: MctpStackConfig

settings.help: This setting determines if modifications to Customer configuable NVARs is to be allowed after close of manufacturing.
settings.label: Post Manufacturing NVAR Configuration Enabled
settings.name: NvarPostManUnLckd

settings.help: This setting is for entering the ODM ID for Intel(R) Services to identify the ODM Board builder.  Note: This  ID is either generated by or registered with Intel(R ) Services Web servers.
settings.label: ODM ID used by Intel(R) Services
settings.name: OdmIDIntelServices

settings.help: This setting allows OEMs to pre-configure the Domain Name Suffix used for PKI provisioning in their firmware image.  Note: For normal out-of- box provisioning functionality this setting should be left empty.
settings.label: PKI Domain Name Suffix
settings.name: PkiDomainSuffix

settings.help: This setting allows OEMs to pre-configure the Domain Name Suffix used for PKI provisioning in their firmware image.  Note: For normal out-of- box provisioning functionality this setting should be left empty.
settings.label: PKI Domain Name Suffix
settings.name: PkiDomainSuffix

settings.help: This setting allows customers to configure the Privacy and Security level for redirection operations.  Default enables all redirection ports (User consent is configurable).  Enhanced enables all redirection ports (User consent is required and cannot be disabled).  Extreme disables all redirection capabilities.
settings.label: Redirection Privacy / Security Level
settings.name: RedirectionPrivSecLevel

settings.help: This setting is for entering the Reserved ID for Intel(R) Services currently not used.
settings.label: Reserved ID used by Intel(R) Services
settings.name: ReservedIdIntelServices

settings.help: This setting is for entering the System Integrator ID for Intel(R) Services to identify the System Integrator.  Note: This  ID is either generated by or registered with Intel(R ) Services Web servers.
settings.label: System Integrator ID used by Intel(R) Services
settings.name: SysIntIdIntelServices
